text:
sam (PM): Kicking off a short thread to lock the DP recruitment funnel + scoring rubric. Need final gating criteria for private preview cohort.
anya (Growth): Goal is 8-10 partners with diverse verticals. Funnel stages: interest form -> qualification call -> tech screen -> onboarding window. Conversion targets: 35% qual call -> tech screen, 70% tech screen -> onboard.
diego (Solutions): Qualification checklist: 1) product fit (2/3 use-cases aligned), 2) engineering bandwidth, 3) data sensitivity OK for private preview. Score 0/1 per item. Need a numeric cutoff.
rachel (Research): Add a signal for evaluation quality: partner has at least 1 canonical user flow that can be exercised programmatically and 2 labeled examples for eval. +1 point each.
miles (Infra): Tech screen must verify tracing + client can send payloads at target qps. We should auto-fail if integration can't produce telemetry in 48h.
sam (PM): Proposal for scoring (0-8): product_fit(0-2), eng_bandwidth(0-1), data_sensitivity(0-1), canonical_flow(0-2), telemetry_ready(0-2). Cutoff 5 to invite. Thoughts?
anya (Growth): I'm nervous cutoff too high. If we want diverse verticals, maybe set 4 and then prioritize by research value.
diego (Solutions): Prioritize research value after cutoff. Also assign a risk flag if customer-facing is high-risk or regulated.
rachel (Research): Add a secondary filter: will partner provide relevance labels for 50 responses over 2 weeks? If yes, +1 research priority.
miles (Infra): For telemetry readiness step include a synthetic-load checklist: a) warmup generator script, b) tracing endpoint verified, c) sample traces logged to our S3 prefix. We'll provide a small harness.
legal-bot: Reminder: intake form must include contact, scope, any data residency reqs, and a checkbox consenting to NDA before receiving SDK or scripts.
oncall-bot: I'll create a template Slack channel and a PagerDuty policy for each partner.
sam (PM): Launch gates for cohort: 1) >=6 partners onboarded, 2) telemetry streams healthy for 72h, 3) 3 partners have submitted canonical prompts and at least 30 eval samples, 4) incident playbook signed. If any gate fails -> delay public announcement.
diego (Solutions): For acceptance we also need a minimum traffic distribution: at least 60% of partners should generate live traffic (not just synthetic) within week 2.
anya (Growth): Recruitment messaging: two templates — one short TL;DR for outreach, one long for legal/ops. I'll draft and share. Suggest we offer a "research credit" incentive: 1 month Dedicated credit + priority support for fully engaged partners.
rachel (Research): Feedback cadence: weekly 30m sync + asynchronous triage in channel. Also require partners to complete a short daily quality check (2-3 minute inline form) during week 1.
miles (Infra): Monitoring spec: capture p50/p95, tokens/request, error rate, fallback_count, cold_start_ratio. We'll expose a per-partner dashboard URL.
sam (PM): Failure modes and kill criteria: (A) Our-side: if p95 > 2x baseline for 48h or critical regressions on >15% of canonical prompts -> auto-throttle and notify. (B) Partner-side: if >25% error rate for 48h or product impact -> partner may pause. Both sides must follow escalation ladder: partner success -> eng oncall -> product -> legal.
diego (Solutions): Can we standardize a short "integration kit"? Contains: SDK + tracing snippet + warmup script + sample eval set template + request sample. Makes onboarding faster.
anya (Growth): Also prepare a one-pager for partners explaining what success looks like: expected outputs, time commitment, incentives, opt-out path. I'll draft.
rachel (Research): For eval comparability we need normalized prompts: provide a prompting style guide and a prompt anonymizer. Partners can submit hashes plus human labels if needed.
miles (Infra): I'll add a small TTL on logs for preview (30d) and log redaction pipeline for PII. Legal to confirm.
legal-bot: Confirmed: 30d default retention; include opt-in for extended access and explicit PII prohibition in eval uploads. Also add export jurisdiction checkbox.
oncall-bot: Action: will provision channel, PD policy, and calendar invite template automatically after we mark partner as onboarded.
sam (PM): Action items: anya draft outreach + one-pager (Wed), diego create integration kit + warmup script (Wed), miles create dashboard & log policy (Thu), rachel write evaluation checklist + daily check template (Thu), legal-bot prepare NDA + intake form update (Thu). I'll compile the cohort scoring sheet and share Monday.
anya (Growth): Quick question: can we run a small "pre-qual" ad on our community newsletter to seed inbound? Might give higher quality leads.
sam (PM): Go for it. Keep copy focused on private preview not public beta.
diego (Solutions): Minor ops ask: in the intake form, add a field "expected weekly requests" so we size infra accordingly.
rachel (Research): Last note: define a simple success metric for the preview: median partner satisfaction >=4/5 and no more than 2 post-onboarding incidents that cause downtime across cohort.
sam (PM): Agreed. Poll: thumbs up on scoring cutoff 5 and gates as written? :thumbsup: :thumbsdown:
anya (Growth): :thumbsup:
diego (Solutions): :thumbsup:
rachel (Research): :thumbsup:
miles (Infra): :thumbsup:
legal-bot: :thumbsup:
sam (PM): Thanks. I'll drop the scoring sheet + intake form draft here in two days for final sign-off.
